referenceFunction.generalComment: The electricity demand for cutting and grinding of the worktops is estimated based on electricity consumption of wood processing. Aluminiumtrihydroxide-acrylic glass can be processed similar to hardwood. The processing losses are assumed to be 10%. Input of packaging materials is estimated based on similar kitchen worktops.; UUID: 28b1b9e6-da8c-3fe3-83be-52cd77261f28
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This data set includes the materials needed for the production of kitchen countertops made from aluminiumtrihydroxide-acrylic glass. The kitchen worktop has a thickness of 12 mm. An average kitchen countertop has the measures of 2400 mm x 600 mm (1.44 m2). The sink is not included. Transport is estimated according to the ecoinvent standard distances for Switzerland.
